old: Admins can export tickets created in the last 30 days as a CSV file. Columns: id, subject, status, created_at, assignee.
new: the export must support any custom date range up to 12 months (not a fixed 30 days), and it must include all custom fields as extra columns
evidence_quote: Decision: the export must support any custom date range up to 12 months (not a fixed 30 days), and it must include all custom fields as extra columns
